title: Such a fun, local activity with great guides!
text: This was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona! Annie and Puli were wonderful and made us feel so welcome! There was cava and snacks for us to munch on throughout the two hours.  Annie provided a detailed history of espadrilles and helped us lace all of the ribbon. You can upgrade and pay an additional fee if you want a heel, or you can make the basic espadrille.
author: traveler9796jr

title: Worth the time
text: Fun experience. You don’t actually make the shoes, but you assemble them. Well tutored hands on activity led by Annie. Learned the history of how espadrilles came about. Unhurried experience. Great snacks and beverages, including cava.
author: Nancy_K

title: This was such a fun...
text: This was such a fun experience! I was the only one in the class and they really made it special. Such a cool way to make a true Barcelona souvenir.
author: James_M

title: Fun and unique
text: This was a fun and interesting experience. The women who ran the class were knowledgeable, friendly, and very patient. I would highly recommend this to all!
author: Randi F

title: Recommended
text: Something else. It’s fun, in the end you have something you’ll actually use, the time frame is long enough to get something decent done, but also not so long that an entire day goes for it. The price is reasonable. However, it should not be higher
author: Krake1997

title: This was one the best...
text: This was one the best parts of our trip and a great family activity! The espadrilles are perfect. The staff and teacher are so patient. Great memory and moments!
author: Alyssa_S

title: Amazing activity
text:
This was the ABSOLUTE best activity I have ever done anywhere. Pilu and Jordi (sorry if spelled their names wrong) were thoroughly entertaining and hospitable. They explained the history of the espadrille while they guided the small group in how to decorate them ourselves. Refreshments were provided which was also wonderful. 
The shop also had beautiful hand made espadrilles and hand painted boots & sneakers. I enjoyed this activity so much, I’d love to come back again with friends.
Recommend highly!! Thanks Pilu & Jordi!
author: ANNA_D

title: Make a pair of authentic espadrilles
text: We had booked a walking of old Barcelona and passed by Handmade Barcelona, a wonderful shop in the old town. I wanted a pair of authentic espadrilles, which are hard to find in Toronto, where I live. Our guide told us that I could book a workshop to make a pair - I was in! I don't do crafts - I don't knit, or crochet or quilt - and the workshop leaders were so kind and supportive. You don't actually make your espadrilles from scratch - whew! - you choose the pair you want and then you decorate them, all the while learning the history of the shoes, which was fascinating. author: charlottee585

title: We are proud owners of our own handmade shoes!
text: I’ve never heard about the Espadrille shoes let alone a workshop. After today’s experience, it is a must do! Stephanie and Pilu were great host. My wife and I had a wonderful time learning about the shoes and building our own shoes. My and and I can say we are proud owners of our own Espadrille shoes.  Bravo!!! Great jobs and great hosts.  Thank you!!!!
author: VictorM_O

title: Fun experience and comfortable unique shoes.
text: The staff here was friendly and knowledgeable, creative and excited about their product line. I will definitely go again and recommend anyone to go there. You will have a one-of-a-kind souvenir that also supports a handmade product.
author: Cleste G
